brandPerception: Carolina reads as a thoughtful, emerging luxury agent in Monmouth County who is riding the Christie's International affiliate halo plus the Teresa Minnick Group's 20+ year reputation. Her personal-brand lever is her bilingual (Spanish/English) fluency combined with a non-traditional background (international diplomacy, education, marketing) — a genuinely differentiated story in a market saturated with lifelong-local agents. Her Instagram-first handle (@carolina.therealtor) signals she understands modern agent branding, but the web doesn't yet reflect a cohesive personal brand: no owned .com, no personal content hub, no owned lead funnel. She is currently a sub-profile under two larger brands (Christie's + Teresa Minnick Group) and every click for her goes to real estate owned by someone else. The opportunity is clear: own her narrative, own her domain, own her leads.
